pages.description: A centered anime portrait features chibi CatNap holding a crescent moon charm inside a decorative starry frame. Highlighted by huge glassy eyes, oversized ears, fluffy cheeks, and sparkling star accents, this clean line art sheet is ideal for coloring with gel pens, soft colored pencils, or fine-liners.

pages.title: Cute CatNap Chibi Crescent Moon Paws Up Poppy Playtime Free Printable Coloring Pages
pages.description: Bring maximum kawaii energy to life with an adorable full-body line art sheet of CatNap stretching out its fluffy paw pads with a cheerful open-mouthed smile. Styled in a super cute chibi anime look featuring big glossy eyes, a crescent moon chest pendant, soft fur details, and a wavy tail, this clean activity page gives kids and young artists a fun template for testing cozy purple pastel shades and soft glowing night-sky highlights.
